compactNotes:
Fixed pixel specs (not proportional to each other). Component: Card / Compact (02 — Components) · Size × Suit × Rank Glyph = 16 masters.

COMMUNITY          38 × 53 · radius 3 · card gap 7
  rank             left 2 · top 3 · font-size 20 (Hanuman 700, line-height 1)
  small suit       left 1.5 · top 25 · font-size 16 → pip height 12
  large suit       right 3 · bottom 3 · font-size 29 → pip height 21.75

HERO               50 × 70 · radius 4
  rank             left 3 · top 3 · font-size 28 (Hanuman 700, line-height 1)
  small suit       left 3 · top 32 · font-size 20 → pip height 15
  large suit       right 3 · bottom 3 · font-size 32 → pip height 24
  pair             overlap 13 (second card x 37) · left −7° · right +3° (rotate about card centre)

COMMON
  shell            background #F2F2F2 · NO border — edge shadow 0 1 1 rgba(0,0,0,.25), 0 2 8 rgba(0,0,0,.25) + 1 px inset ring rgba(255,255,255,.10) · no inner panel
  colours          Hearts / Diamonds #E0001B · Clubs / Spades #3B3C39 (rank + both suits use the suit colour)
  suits            approved pip SVGs (Heart 30 × 37.5 · Diamond 27.4 × 37.5 · Club 29.4 × 32.6 · Spade 27.3 × 37.5), uniform scale,
                   pip height = 0.75 × spec font-size, positioned by the pip's own box
  rank 10          approved custom 10 glyph matched to the Hanuman 700 numeral height: visible height 0.73 × font-size
                   (14.6 community · 20.4 hero), visible top = top + 0.02 × font-size; same-colour centre stroke 6 % of that height
                   (included in the height); path data closed per sub-path (Z) so the stroked '1' keeps its top-left corner
  composition      one top-left index (rank + small suit) and one large suit — no bottom index, no pip layouts,
                   no court art (courtStyle ignored), no decorative Ace

ARCHITECTURE
  Standard = visual richness, ≥ ~100 px. Compact = mobile / small boards, instant rank + suit + colour recognition.
  Shared: 5:7-ish card shape, rank identity, suit identity, colour rules. Compact reuses existing rank font, 10 glyph and pip SVGs —
  standalone compact-card SVG files required: 0.   API idea (not final): <Card rank="K" suit="spades" variant="compact" size="community" | "hero" />

Note: Hanuman 700 (compact only) vs 400 (standard) — same family, chosen for small-size weight. Earlier v1 explorations are kept above as superseded.
